product_one_liner.value: DesignArena lets people creating websites, apps, images, video, presentations, and other media prompt and compare leading AI models, while crowdsourced preferences rank the models' outputs.
product_one_liner.notes: The product homepage describes creating with top AI models, and Y Combinator characterizes it as a crowdsourced design benchmark.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer have no pricing link, and the pricing URL only redirects back to itself rather than showing plans or prices.

named_customers.notes: The closest public customer research says there are zero named customers; TechCrunch describes a first frontier-lab deal but does not name the lab.

employee_band.notes: The company LinkedIn profile reports 12 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: Y Combinator lists San Francisco and LinkedIn identifies the company locality as San Francisco, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: Y Combinator lists Design Arena as founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog has multiple technical posts on its Agent Runner evaluation harness and on the implementation of its slide-generation pipeline; the posts do not display individual author bylines.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index lists several product/API articles, including a quickstart, API overview, arenas, models, and leaderboard guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page lists an ML Research Engineer role, with a linked live ML Engineer posting.

model_provider.value: DesignArena publicly lists a multi-provider model catalog, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google (Gemini), Meta (Llama), NVIDIA, and Amazon Bedrock, rather than identifying a single exclusive provider.
model_provider.notes: The privacy notice says the AI products use models from the organizations listed in Model Terms, which names these providers/model families.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in describing its cloud-provider infrastructure.

last_funding.notes: TechCrunch reported the $7.9 million seed round on August 3, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $7.9 million seed round announced August 3, 2026, falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current open-role list includes an open application, ML Research Engineer, Platform, and Founding Launch Designer, but no SDR, BDR, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On November 2, 2026, DesignArena announced PDF Arena as a new evaluation product, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current small team is listed as three; the founders/Chief AI-ML leader were already in those roles by July-August 2025, before the 12-month window, and no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable public documentation index and current careers listings do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
